title: [Web] Rescue villagers. Give them jobs. Hold the wall for 5 days. — SUNHOLD, a free village-defense game in your browser
author: marckamb
selftext:
Game Title: SUNHOLD

Playable Link: https://marc254.itch.io/sunhold

Platform: Web — plays in your phone or desktop browser, nothing to install

Free to Play Status: Free to play

Involvement: Solo developer

\---

You're the king, and you start with nothing but a campfire and a crown.

Villagers come running out of the forest with wolves behind them. Every one you save is yours to command: put a bow in her hands and she climbs a tower. Give him a hammer and he builds your palisade, chops the forest, raises your walls. Send one to the gold rocks, one to hold the gate with a sword. Nobody fights for you until you save them first.

Then night falls, and everything you built gets tested. Wolves pour in from the dark. Brutes walk straight up to your palisade and start breaking it down — and behind it, your fire, your people, your whole little kingdom of tents.

Survive the day and the village grows: clear enough forest and the walls themselves move outward — more land, more towers, more mouths to save. Five days. A boss on the fifth. Beat it, and endless survival unlocks.

The quick pitch:  
•  🏹 Your army is people you rescued — every fighter started as a fleeing villager  
•  🪓 Your village physically expands as you clear the forest  
•  🔥 Your campfire is the heart of the village — defend it  
•  📱 Free, in your browser, no download, no ads, no pay-to-win, works on your phone  
•  🌲 A full 5-day campaign + boss + endless mode (and a Winter chapter is on the way — where the fire eats wood all night, and cold is the real enemy)

Three questions for anyone who tries it:  
1.  How far did you get? (Day 3 is where it starts to bite.)  
2.  Who was your first rescue — archer, builder, collector or soldier?  
3.  Did your fire survive the boss?

Link is right at the top — it runs in the browser, you're playing in under a minute. Tell me how your village died. Or didn't. Your feedback back is really important to us.

comments.author: marckamb
comments.body: Controls, one breath: drag (or mouse) to move the king, stand on a glowing pad to build, tap a villager to give them their job. 🔥 Tip from every village that ever fell: watch your builders during the day — a lazy village is a dead village. I'm the dev, I'm here, I'll answer everything
